# Procurement policy (applies to every vendor review)

1. Report all costs in GBP. Convert each invoice line at the rate for its own month in
   `finance/fx-2026.csv` (no single annual rate).
2. Contract documents (contracts, amendments, credit notes) override invoices; later documents
   override earlier ones. Analyst summaries and drafts are not sources.
3. For SLA purposes count only incidents with severity P1 **and** status `confirmed`. An incident
   id that appears more than once is one incident.
4. A vendor breaches its SLA when its counted P1 incidents in the period exceed its contract threshold.
5. Check `corporate/notices.md` before recommending any vendor.

2	
3	1. Report all costs in GBP. Convert each invoice line at the rate for its own month in

6	   override earlier ones. Analyst summaries and drafts are not sources.

8	   id that appears more than once is one incident.
9	4. A vendor breaches its SLA when its counted P1 incidents in the period exceed its contract threshold.
10	5. Check `corporate/notices.md` before recommending any vendor.

8	   id that appears more than once is one incident.
9	4. A vendor breaches its SLA when its counted P1 incidents in the period exceed its contract threshold.

**Determining Eligibility**

I am now confirming renewal eligibility, noting that Ombra Analytics has breached its SLA due to 3 P1 incidents against a threshold of 2. Pellucid AI, conversely, remains eligible with 2 P1 incidents against their threshold of 2.

**Confirming Vendor Renewals**

I have confirmed that Strand Hosting, Tessel Cloud, and Vesper Metrics all remain eligible for renewal based on their P1 incident counts and SLA thresholds. My current focus is on finalizing the full details for Vesper Metrics, specifically their invoiced amounts.

A continuación se presenta la revisión completa de los quince proveedores de software para el período de enero a septiembre de 2026, verificada conforme a la política de compras (`policy.md`), los tipos de cambio mensuales (`finance/fx-2026.csv`), los documentos contractuales vigentes (contratos, enmiendas y notas de crédito) y los avisos corporativos (`corporate/notices.md`).

### Resumen por proveedor (enero–septiembre de 2026)

| Proveedor | Moneda contrato | Coste total (GBP) | Incidentes P1 computables (`confirmed` únicos) | Umbral SLA (máx. P1) | ¿Incumple SLA (`breach`)? | Estado para renovación |
| :--- | :---: | ---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Brightwater Data** | GBP | 59.129,65 | 1 | 2 | No (`false`) | Renovable |
| **Cobalt Ledger** | EUR | 46.280,48 | 4 | 4 | No (`false`) | Renovable |
| **Fennel Networks** | GBP | 48.962,26 | 3 | 2 | Sí (`true`) | No renovable (incumple SLA: 3 > 2) |
| **Halden Systems** | GBP | 50.394,31 | 4 | 4 | No (`false`) | Renovable |
| **Ironbark IT** | GBP | 36.687,16 | 3 | 3 | No (`false`) | **No elegible** (`corporate/notices.md`: adquirido por un competidor) |
| **Kestrel Ops** | USD | 37.990,08 | 1 | 2 | No (`false`) | Renovable |
| **Larch Compute** | EUR | 49.428,61 | 4 | 3 | Sí (`true`) | No renovable (incumple SLA: 4 > 3) |
| **Marlow Secure** | GBP | 45.137,43 | 5 | 4 | Sí (`true`) | No renovable (incumple SLA: 5 > 4 tras deduplicar IDs) |
| **Norvik Data** | EUR | 50.989,43 | 6 | 4 | Sí (`true`) | No renovable (incumple SLA: 6 > 4) |
| **Ombra Analytics** | GBP | 57.037,31 | 3 | 2 | Sí (`true`) | No renovable (incumple SLA: 3 > 2) |
| **Pellucid AI** | USD | 47.325,62 | 2 | 2 | No (`false`) | Renovable |
| **Quarry Labs** | GBP | 69.935,30 | 4 | 4 | No (`false`) | Renovable |
| **Strand Hosting** | GBP | 44.736,33 | 1 | 2 | No (`false`) | Renovable (incluye nota de crédito `CN-0042` por -3.150,00 GBP) |
| **Tessel Cloud** | GBP | 62.119,79 | 3 | 3 | No (`false`) | Renovable (3 incidentes únicos tras deduplicar `INC-TES200` e `INC-TES201`) |
| **Vesper Metrics** | GBP | 78.466,33 | 3 | 4 | No (`false`) | Renovable (la Enmienda n.º 2 anula el descuento de la Enmienda n.º 1) |

### Notas clave de verificación
* **Ajustes documentales sobre facturas:**
  * **Strand Hosting:** El total facturado bruto es de `47.886,33 GBP`, al cual se aplica la nota de crédito `credit-note-CN-0042.md` del 30 de septiembre de 2026 (`-3.150,00 GBP`), resultando en un coste neto de **`44.736,33 GBP`**.
  * **Vesper Metrics:** La `amendment-2-2026-05.md` (firmada el 28 de mayo de 2026) cancela íntegramente el descuento del 20 % previsto en la `amendment-1-2026-04.md`, por lo que se mantienen los importes facturados (**`78.466,33 GBP`**).
